compute_density_p_z_h_given_y: compute the conditional density P(z, h | y) from a pandas DataFrame with y_true, y_model, and reader_score columns
compute_sensitivity_sens: compute sensitivity estimates for all operating points from a discretized joint probability distribution P(z, h | y)
compute_specificity_spec: compute specificity estimates for all operating points from a discretized joint probability distribution P(z, h | y)
compute_advantage_phi: compute the advantage function Advantage(z) across all operating points using a trade-off parameter lambda
compute_composite_sensitivity_comp_sens: compute composite sensitivity estimates for a CoDoC model given a deferral function and operating points
